create_State_for_grpc_testing: create a State instance to manage gRPC RPC state with invocation metadata and request lists
send_initial_metadata_with_State: send initial metadata on a State object using send_initial_metadata to notify waiting callers
add_request_to_State: add a request to the State object using add_request and notify waiting threads
terminate_State_with_response: terminate a State RPC with a response, trailing metadata, status code, and details
take_response_from_State: take the next response from a State object using take_response and wait if none available
